messages:
alyssa: quick idea from today's onboarding trial: try a tiny "primeline" handoff for large tenants — aim: quiet cold starts + early renewal signal capture

miguel: name checks out. what's in the primeline flow?

alyssa: high level: 1) lightweight prewarm (top intents only), 2) staggered warm bursts to avoid pool contention, 3) aggressive streaming fallbacks for tail latency, 4) auto-feedback hook for CS

samira: how do we pick the "top intents"? can we make it part of kickoff?

alyssa: yes — CS collects 8-12 high-value intents during kickoff + 3 golden example prompts. add to a small manifest CS uploads to ENG. ENG runs ephemeral prewarm job scoped to the account's dedicated pool (or reserved slice)

ryan: sample manifest (short) that ENG can accept:

```
# primeline_prefill.json
account: ACME_CORP_7
golden_examples: ["classify invoice", "extract totals", "rewrite policy blurb"]
prefill_duration: 10m
stagger_windows: [0s, 75s]
burst_rates: {initial: 8r/s, peak: 3r/s}
telemetry_labels: ["cs:samira","onboard:primeline-v0"]
```

miguel: nice. on runtime side we also want an early hint header so the serving layer can prioritize KV warmup: X-Primeline-Hint: top-intent-id. helps evict low-use slots temporarily.

alyssa: streaming fallbacks: require client to accept partial streams + reassembly. policy: if p90 generation latency > 600ms for >5% of requests in the first 30m, switch incremental streams + lower-q model for delayed tokens. log counts to telemetry and push a renewal-risk score update.

samira: renewal-risk score? how do we derive that from signals?

alyssa: simple formula for now: base 100 -> minus 20 if avg latency > 500ms in first 2h, minus 30 if error-rate > 3% in first 2h, minus 10 if client feedback negative. map ranges to green/yellow/red. surface in CS dashboard and trigger a follow-up if yellow or red.

ryan: propose adding a micro-survey hook after 50 queries: quick 3-option feedback (happy/ok/unhappy) + opt-in comment. feed to CS and tie to renewal-risk scoring. small ask for customers but high signal. :bar_chart:

cs_bot: reminder set: send primeline/first-50 webhook within 24h if not received. will ping channel. :bell:

miguel: rollback steps? we should be explicit.
alyssa: yes — if error-rate or latency crosses thresholds during any burst window:
- switch route to canary model
- drain prewarm pool (no new prefill jobs)
- open a short postmortem ticket and notify CS owner

samira: can we get a TL;DR handoff checklist for the kickoff slide?
alyssa: Yup — TL;DR:
- CS: collect 8	6 intents + 3 golden prompts, expected QPS, business priorities
- ENG: run primeline_prefill, confirm KV hit-rate > 55% after 8m, enable staggered bursts
- CS+ENG: enable streaming fallback, wire primeline first-50 webhook, monitor first-2h telemetry and renewal-risk

ryan: i'll add a tiny diagram for the Friday enablement deck.

alyssa: thanks — i'll draft the one-pager and attach here EOD. linking playbook after draft. :white_check_mark:

cs_bot: primeline handoff doc created: https://internal.redwood/cs/primeline/1796666789 — follow-up reminder in 24h.
